04

Day by Day

Three bases across seven days, with the driving front-loaded so the Italian days stay unhurried.

Wed 2 Sep

PS + W arrive

✈ LUX → ZRH · then on to Winterthur

PS and W fly into Zürich late morning and carry on to Winterthur, so the whole group is together the evening before the drive.

  • Swiss LUX 10:15 → ZRH 11:15 — see the flight panel above.
  • Zürich → Winterthur — around 25 minutes by train from the airport.
  • Evening in Winterthur — pack the car, sort the route, early night before a long driving day.
Thu 3 Sep

Winterthur → Reggio Emilia

▾ 5–5.5h · Gotthard · Lugano · Milano

The one genuinely long drive. Leaving early makes Lugano a natural lunch stop and still puts you in Emilia-Romagna in daylight.

  • Gotthard — check the tunnel queue before committing; the pass road over the top is the better option if traffic has built up, and the nicer one for a break.
  • Lugano — roughly the halfway mark. Lakefront, shade, easy walk.
  • After Milano — the Po plain runs flat and fast down to Reggio Emilia.
Thu 3 – Sat 5 Sep

Emilia-Romagna

2 nights · base: Alle Siepi

Alle Siepi

REGGIO EMILIA · 2 NIGHTS · SEP 3 → SEP 5
Planned — ready to book
✓Accommodation selected →Next step: Book

Our chosen base for the two Emilia-Romagna nights. Not reserved yet — the booking still needs to be placed.

View & Book Alle Siepi ↗
  • Parma — about 45 min west. Piazza del Duomo, the Battistero, and a compact shaded centre.
  • Bologna — about 1h 10 south-east. The porticoes, Piazza Maggiore and the two towers; the biggest day out of the three.
  • Closer by — Reggio Emilia's own centre is on the doorstep, and Modena is roughly 35 min.
  • Pick two, not three — Parma and Bologna in one day is possible but makes for a lot of driving on a rest day.
Sat 5 – Sun 6 Sep

Lake Garda

▾ 1.5–2h from Reggio Emilia · 1 night

The one open decision in the trip. Two of the three options are inland at Lonato; one is in Moniga, on the lake itself.

South-west shore — the three options in context
Hover a marker for detail.Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors
Option 1
Agriturismo Villa Gaia
LONATO DEL GARDA · INLAND
  • Farm stay with a pool and a restaurant on site
  • Listed as pet friendly — confirm for a large dog
  • Set back from the lake, roughly 10–15 min drive to the shore
  • Quietest of the three, and the most outdoor space
View on Booking ↗
Option 2
H2O Rooms
VIA PERGOLA 10, MONIGA DEL GARDA
  • The only one of the three actually on the lake
  • Walkable to the Moniga waterfront and to cafés
  • Pet friendly — a fee may apply, worth checking when booking
  • Closest to Manerba, the Rocca and the dog beach
View on Booking ↗
Option 3
LM House 01
VIA MAGLIO 3, 25017 LONATO
  • Self-catering house — more room for four adults
  • Inland at Lonato, same side as Villa Gaia
  • A whole property usually suits a large dog best
  • Check the dog policy and whether parking is on site
View on Booking ↗

The real trade-off: H2O Rooms puts you on the water for the only lake night, at the cost of space. Villa Gaia and LM House 01 both give more room and a quieter setting, but every trip to the shore becomes a short drive.

  • Rocca di Manerba — headland walk with the best view over the southern basin; roughly 30–40 min up.
  • Salò — the longest promenade on this shore, about 20 min north. Good evening option.
  • Dog-friendly beach — Manerba has a designated dog beach on the south shore; check this season's opening before setting out.
  • Swimming — the water is still warm in early September and much quieter than August.
Sun 6 – Mon 7 Sep

Franciacorta & Lake Iseo

▾ 45–75 min from Garda · 1 night

HILL COLLE — camere & bistrot

ERBUSCO / FRANCIACORTA · 1 NIGHT · SEP 6 → SEP 7
Planned — ready to book
✓Accommodation selected →Next step: Book

Chosen for the final Italian night. Not reserved yet. The bistrot on site removes the need to drive anywhere for dinner on the shortest evening of the trip.

View & Book HILL COLLE ↗
  • Why here and not Milan — Erbusco sits in the Franciacorta vineyards between Garda and Lake Iseo, so the last night stays rural instead of becoming a city stopover.
  • Lake Iseo — about 25 min north. Quieter than Garda; Riva di Solto and the western cliff road are the scenic stretch.
  • Franciacorta — the sparkling wine region. Cellar visits generally need booking a day or two ahead.
Mon 7 Sep

Franciacorta → Winterthur

▾ 4–4.5h · back over the Gotthard

Leaving Erbusco late morning puts the group back in Winterthur for the evening.

  • Break the drive — Lugano or Bellinzona both work well as a stop on the way north.
  • Monday traffic — the Gotthard is usually calmer northbound on a Monday than on a Sunday evening.
Tue 8 Sep

PS + W fly home

✈ ZRH → LUX · 17:45 → 18:40

A late-afternoon flight leaves the whole day free — Winterthur or Zürich, unhurried, before heading to the airport.

  • Swiss ZRH 17:45 → LUX 18:40 — see the flight panel above.
